subject: Design Lab: Inference architecture deep-dive — scheduling
messages:
From: Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@asteriahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Liu <marcus.liu@asteriahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Design Lab: Inference architecture deep-dive — scheduling

Hi Karthik / Laura,

Thanks again for the discovery call yesterday — Marcus and I found it really helpful. We'd like to move into a focused "Design Lab" with your engineering team: a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive to validate an architecture for inference, discuss latency/cost tradeoffs, and outline an initial rollout plan. High-level goals:

- Review our current data flow and access patterns (batch vs. real-time).
- Align on latency SLOs and failover behavior.
- Surface potential integration points (auth, VPC peering, audit logs).
- Identify measurement points for early ML/infra experiments.

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue Aug 25, 10:00–11:30
- Wed Aug 26, 14:00–15:30
- Thu Aug 27, 09:00–10:30

We attached a short prelim architecture diagram and a sample dataset excerpt to help guide the conversation. If you need a different format, tell me and I can re-export.

Can you confirm who from your side should be in the room (we'd like an SE lead + someone from product/infra), and which slot works best?

Thanks,
Samantha Jones
Technical Program Manager
Asteria Health
[Attachment: asteria-prelim-arch.pdf (PDF, 320 KB)]
[Attachment: asteria-sample-dataset.csv (CSV, 54 KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@asteriahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Design Lab: Inference architecture deep-dive — scheduling

Samantha — thanks for sending this over and for the clear goals. Happy to run the Design Lab from our side. Proposed attendees from Redwood: me (pre-sales lead), Neha (solutions engineer), and Laura (account lead).

All three proposed slots work for us; our preference is Wed Aug 26 14:00 PT so Neha can lead the latency/throughput portion. If that slot is good for you, we'll send a calendar invite and include a short pre-read.

Agenda suggestion (60–90 min):
1) 5 min quick intros + expected outcomes
2) 20 min Asteria current infra & constraints (you / Marcus)
3) 30 min detailed inference architecture discussion (Neha leads)
4) 15–25 min integration and next steps (rollout checklist, measurement plan)

A couple of asks to make the session high value:
- If possible, please confirm peak RPS and average request size for the sample dataset.
- Share any compliance/retention requirements beyond standard HIPAA controls.

I'll attach a lightweight capacity estimate workbook after we lock the time (so you get a rough GPU/memory sketch for discussion). I've also linked the HubSpot deal and a tentative calendar event so it's easy to accept.

Links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567  |  https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=7f3k2l_example

-Karthik
Principal Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@asteriahealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Design Lab: Inference architecture deep-dive — scheduling

Thanks Samantha — I'm looking forward to this. I'll run the architecture walkthrough and bring a short checklist for validation (sequence lengths, batching strategy, KV cache strategy, quantization options). A few quick clarifying questions so I can tailor the session:

- Expected peak RPS (or concurrent requests) during business hours?
- Typical prompt / payload size (tokens and MB) and variance patterns?
- Any hard constraints on data residency or retention (beyond HIPAA)?
- Do you want a live demo with a sample inference run, or prefer whiteboard + proposed config?

If you can drop answers in a reply (or attach a short doc), we'll use that to size the capacity estimate.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@asteriahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Design Lab: Inference architecture deep-dive — scheduling

Hi Karthik / Neha — Wed Aug 26 at 14:00 PT works for us. Thanks for the agenda — that looks great.

Quick answers to Neha's questions:
- Peak ~120 RPS for auth-related calls, but inference surface for now will be bursty, ~20–40 RPS typical.
- Typical prompt payload ~2–4 KB, worst-case around 50 KB for longer context. Token windows vary but usually under 2k tokens.
- Data residency: must remain in US regions; retention default 90 days but some records tied to clinical review must be retained for 7 years — we'll surface the list in the pre-read.
- We'd like a live run using a redacted sample; Marcus will attach an anonymized sample payload and a slightly updated architecture PDF.

Please send a calendar invite for Wed Aug 26 14:00 PT and we can invite our infra person if needed.

Thanks,
Samantha Jones
Technical Program Manager
Asteria Health
